entities.summary: David Andrew Taylor is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player who played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Los Angeles Kings from 1977 to 1994. Taylor was a star player at Clarkson University for four seasons while being drafted by both the National Hockey League (NHL) and World Hockey Association in 1975. He made it to the NHL in 1977 with the Los Angeles Kings. The 1980-81 season saw Taylor be labeled as part of a "Triple Crown Line" alongside centre Marcel Dionne and left winger Charlie Simmer, as all three players scored 100 points each, with Taylor's 112 points being a career high and the first of two straight 100-point seasons.
